primaryIntent: PHP를 사용하는 기존 회사 홈페이지의 지원 종료·취약점 패치 필요성을 이해하고 안전한 전환 및 리뉴얼 범위를 결정하기
websiteTask: 기존 홈페이지의 PHP 환경 전환, 코드 호환성 검증, 유지관리와 재구축 범위 판단
overlapDecision: 기존 칼럼에는 PHP 지원 상태와 7→8 호환성·보안 패치를 함께 다루는 글이 없음. 일반 노후 홈페이지·유지보수 계약 칼럼은 내부 링크로 보완.
searchData: 연결된 Search Console 근거 없음. 검색량·순위·전환 성과 주장 없음.
conversion: 구체적인 업데이트 방법을 공유하고, 버전 전환만으로 가능한 경우와 리뉴얼 검토가 필요한 경우를 구분. 현재 주소·호스팅 안내·CMS·오류 기능·보존할 콘텐츠와 URL을 준비해 nuvio 상담으로 연결.
caseEvidence: 검증된 PHP 업그레이드 고객 사례가 없어 특정 포트폴리오를 기술 전환 실적으로 연결하지 않음.

sources.supports: 8.2–8.6의 지원 상태·기한, 일반 지원과 보안 수정 단계 구분
each/create_function 제거, count TypeError, 숫자/문자열 비교 변경
PHP 보안 및 안정성을 위한 업데이트 유지
PHP 8 계열에서도 지속되는 CVE 보안 수정
CMS와 확장 기능 업데이트·백업 등 보안 운영
패키지 버전 표기만으로 취약 여부를 단정할 수 없는 백포트 예외

images.artDirection: 차분한 아이스 그레이·차콜, 스틸 블루와 코랄 포인트의 건축 단면·판화 일러스트. 공포를 부추기는 해커 장면 배제.

plan.subject: 홈페이지와 교체 모듈
plan.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a premium Korean editorial blog thumbnail for website agency nuvio. Landscape 1600x900, exact 16:9. Pale ice-gray background, charcoal typography, coral vermilion and restrained steel blue accents, precise screen-print / architectural cutaway illustration, crisp matte paper NOT glossy 3D. Left 62% headline, exact three Korean lines: "홈페이지 PHP" / "보안 업데이트" / "왜 필요할까?". Consistent Korean glyph height roughly 110–125px at 1600 width, generous line spacing, not oversized poster letters. Small discreet "nuvio" top-left. Small bottom line exactly "버전 확인 · 호환성 · 안전한 전환". Right 38% a neatly designed abstract webpage surface lifting to reveal replaceable small server modules and one coral maintenance tab below it, looks like professional architectural section drawing, no hooded hacker, no warning catastrophe, no lock dominating scene, no logos other than nuvio, no additional words or version numbers. Leave safe crop margins 70px, small-card legibility.

plan.subject: 환경: 웹페이지를 건물로 비유한 내부 단면
plan.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Wide 16:9 1600x900 editorial conceptual architectural cutaway for article about maintaining a PHP business website. An elegant minimal service webpage appears as a freestanding clean pale rectangular facade in a spacious ice-gray environment, front surface looks orderly and operational with abstract dark text bars and modest image blocks, right edge peeled away revealing internal modular server components and maintenance inspection marks in coral and steel blue. Architecture-style isometric ink drawing with light matte textures, sophisticated print illustration, wide environmental view. Explain that visible normal operation does not prove hidden software is maintained. No readable words, no PHP version digits, no hacker, no actual client or software interface, no 3D glossy icons, no shield/lock visual shorthand.

plan.meaning: 기존 코드와 새 환경의 호환성 조정
plan.subject: 물체: 서로 다른 연결 부품과 어댑터
plan.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. 1600x900 wide 16:9 editorial close-up illustration of a precise technical workbench: two differently shaped matte connector plugs cannot fit directly, a carefully drawn adapter in the center being measured with a thin steel gauge. Abstract hardware metaphor for old PHP application code and a new runtime requiring compatibility adjustments, NOT an actual PHP product or performance result. Offwhite and cool gray backdrop, coral highlights at the mismatch, steel blue on the corrected adapter, charcoal outlines, fine engraved / screenprint textures. Close framing and strong negative space, no browser panels, no server rack, no text, no numbers, no brand marks, no locks, no glossy 3D. Distinct from a wide architecture scene.

plan.subject: 사람: 테스트 화면과 점검표를 확인하는 손
plan.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Landscape 16:9 1600x900. Editorial illustration showing an adult website manager's hands comparing a separate testing copy of a service website and a short feature checklist, over-the-shoulder intimate crop with only partial shoulder and hands. One laptop on the left with minimal abstract service page and a small isolated test indicator in coral; on the right a clearly organized backup folder and handwritten-style check marks on paper, all no readable text. Realistic human anatomy rendered as sophisticated matte ink and lightly textured print illustration, pale ice-gray background, restrained steel blue and coral accents, natural gentle light. Human decision about testing and restoring before a website update. No actual nuvio employee or client, no fake metrics, no warning hacker, no multiple identical browser frames. Focus on the human review rather than desk clutter.
